content:
CI failed on the first PR I had Claude make, with

error: Lean process for /home/runner/work/TauCeti/TauCeti/pr/.lake/tmp/tmp.ad2SM8fmox/LintEnvDriver.lean exceeded the 300s wall-clock limit (TERM, then KILL after 30s)
Error: lint-env: driver/linter failure: no lint report header found (lean exit 124) — see output above
LINT-ENV: FAIL — driver/linter failure: no lint report header found (lean exit 124) — see output above
Error: Process completed with exit code 1.

This looks like something that cannot be fixed on my side, correct? So, what should I do?
@Kim Morrison
It might resolve itself, I have gotten CI failing for what I assume are similar reasons and I've never had to do anything.
Does this need re-running the failed CI step (as in Mathlib)? Or is CI triggered again automatically without a new commit?

So it will need triggering again. The most likely thing is that you get a review asking for some changes and once you do that, CI will trigger and pass (this might just be a transient issue). If not pushing an empty commit can also trigger CI again.
I've told Claude to push an empty commit; CI is running again, but did not yet get to where it was failing.
I also had to re-trigger CI twice for a recent PR. I think the timeout should be increased. Filed here: https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/issues/5927
Sorry, just caught up with this. Fixed now, just by increasing the limit a lot...
We were close to the limit all along, and there was no real reason to be limiting the timing of this run, just an AI being overzealous.
